intro: Productivity here is mostly scope: work that was uneconomic or impossible solo becomes routine — with proof and review still required.

rows.outcome: Fast UI / tool prototype from a crisp brief
rows.note: Useful for demos; still needs an engineer’s taste for production.

rows.outcome: Agentic work inside a real multi-repo codebase
rows.note: The IDE becomes a cockpit: read, patch, test, iterate.

rows.outcome: Remote target investigation with a human in the loop
rows.note: Powerful and easy to over-trust — proof class matters more than chatter.

rows.outcome: Parallel agents on one product loop
rows.note: Feels like a small squad for short bursts; review load stays on the human.
Skills and signed patterns beat “we talked about this in a chat once”.
We do not claim a universal speedup. Measurement is honest — see Measure.
